workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain census tract polygons suitable for identifying tracts intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census tract polygon dataset covering State College borough. Do not assume suitability beyond the returned metadata.

workflow_steps.title: Intersect census tracts with State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Create the polygon zones representing census tracts that intersect the supplied State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersection overlay between the retrieved census tract polygons and the supplied State College borough boundary. Preserve the census tract identifying attributes needed in the output.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate the mean raster elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate mean zonal elevation for each polygon in the intersected census tract layer. Use the replacement input_1 DEM retrieved by task_retrieve_replacement_dem and verify that its inspected bounds cover the supplied borough boundary. Retain input_2 as the required supplied DEM and do not use the rejected partial candidate artifact.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve replacement DEM covering State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a raster elevation candidate satisfying the required spatial coverage for the State College borough extent.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available raster elevation dataset covering the required State College borough extent, excluding the rejected candidate and blocked intersection artifact. Do not assume suitability beyond the returned metadata.
